HTMLDocument.prototype.source: Chromium, as every engine ships it: Object.getPrototypeOf(document) is HTMLDocument.prototype, whose prototype is Document.prototype; window.HTMLDocument is its own interface object, whose prototype is Document; HTMLDocument.prototype has its own constructor (HTMLDocument) and @@toStringTag ("HTMLDocument", non-writable, configurable). @webref/idl has no HTMLDocument (HTML makes window.HTMLDocument an alias of Document). Spec §4.
